import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "400"
failureMessage = "Input validation failed"
failureError = "One or more create inputs are invalid."
failureResult = "{}"
organizationName = sys.argv[1].strip()
deploymentName = sys.argv[2].strip()
descriptionValue = sys.argv[3]
definitionName = sys.argv[4].strip()
usePreferred = sys.argv[5].strip().lower() == "true"
versionText = sys.argv[6].strip()
poolSelector = sys.argv[7].strip()
instancePrefix = sys.argv[8].strip()
startIndexText = sys.argv[9].strip()
digitCountText = sys.argv[10].strip()
blueprintsText = sys.argv[11].strip() or "[]"
qualifiersText = sys.argv[12].strip() or "[]"
scheduleSelector = sys.argv[13].strip()
rollout = sys.argv[14].strip()
tagsText = sys.argv[15].strip() or "[]"
namePattern = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\- _]{0,31}$")
prefixPattern = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]{0,31}$")
errors = []
if not organizationName:
    errors.append("Workload Organization must not be blank.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(deploymentName):
    errors.append("Workload Deployment Name must be 1-32 supported characters and start alphanumerically.")
if len(descriptionValue) > 1024 or (descriptionValue and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9]", descriptionValue)):
    errors.append("Description must be at most 1024 characters and, when nonempty, start alphanumerically.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(definitionName):
    errors.append("Workload Definition Name is invalid.")
try:
    definitionVersion = int(versionText)
except Exception:
    definitionVersion = 0
if not usePreferred and definitionVersion < 1:
    errors.append("Workload Definition Version must be at least 1 when preferred version is false.")
if not poolSelector:
    errors.append("Resource Pool Name or Moid must not be blank.")
if not prefixPattern.fullmatch(instancePrefix):
    errors.append("Workload Instance Prefix must be 1-32 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores and start alphanumerically.")
try:
    startIndex = int(startIndexText)
except Exception:
    startIndex = 0
if startIndex < 1:
    errors.append("Start Index for Suffix must be at least 1.")
try:
    digitCount = int(digitCountText)
except Exception:
    digitCount = 0
if digitCount < 1 or digitCount > 4:
    errors.append("Digit Count must be from 1 through 4.")
if rollout not in {"Batch","Canary"}:
    errors.append("Rollout Strategy must be Batch or Canary.")
try:
    blueprints = json.loads(blueprintsText)
    qualifiers = json.loads(qualifiersText)
    tags = json.loads(tagsText)
    if not isinstance(blueprints, list) or not isinstance(qualifiers, list) or not isinstance(tags, list):
        raise ValueError("Blueprint overrides, qualifiers, and tags must each be JSON arrays.")
    for tag in tags:
        if not isinstance(tag, dict) or not set(tag).issubset({"Key","Value"}) or not isinstance(tag.get("Key"), str) or not (1 <= len(tag["Key"]) <= 356) or not isinstance(tag.get("Value",""), str) or len(tag.get("Value","")) > 256:
            raise ValueError("Each tag must contain only a 1-356 character Key and optional Value of at most 256 characters.")
except Exception as exc:
    blueprints = qualifiers = tags = []
    errors.append("JSON input validation failed: " + str(exc))
escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'", "''")
escapedDeploymentName = deploymentName.replace("'", "''")
escapedDefinitionName = definitionName.replace("'", "''")
escapedPoolSelector = poolSelector.replace("'", "''")
escapedInstancePrefix = instancePrefix.replace("'", "''")
escapedScheduleSelector = scheduleSelector.replace("'", "''")
definitionClause = "PreferredVersion eq true" if usePreferred else "Version eq " + str(definitionVersion)
blueprintsJson = json.dumps(blueprints, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
qualifiersJson = json.dumps(qualifiers, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
tagsJson = json.dumps(tags, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
usePreferredText = "true" if usePreferred else "false"
scheduleSupplied = "true" if scheduleSelector else "false"
if errors:
    failureError = " ".join(errors)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))
else:
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"

    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[5])

    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("Results is not an array.")

        failureCode = "404"
        failureMessage = "Workload definition was not found"
        failureError = "The exact name/version selection returned zero matches."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":0}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureCode = "409"
        failureMessage = "Definition version selection was ambiguous"
        failureError = "The exact definition selector returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required. Multiple preferred versions are refused."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("ClassId") != "workload.WorkloadDefinition" or item.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadDefinition":

        definitionMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(definitionMoid) or str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:

        organization = item.get("Organization")

        if usePreferred and item.get("PreferredVersion") is not True:
            raise ValueError("The selected definition is not marked PreferredVersion.")
        if not usePreferred and item.get("Version") != expectedVersion:
            raise ValueError("The selected definition Version does not match.")
        validation = item.get("ValidationInformation")
        if not isinstance(validation, dict) or validation.get("State") != "Valid":
            failureCode = "422"
            failureMessage = "Workload definition is not valid"
            failureError = "The selected definition ValidationInformation.State is not Valid."
            failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"ValidationInformation":validation}, separators=(",",":"))
        else:
            definitionJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
            status = "ready"
            failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
            failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    if failureCode == "502":
        failureError = "The definition response failed validation: " + str(exc)
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

import sys

status = "invalid"

failureMessage = "Collision response was invalid"

try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    results = envelope.get("Results") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("Results is not an array.")
    if len(results) != 0:
        failureCode = "409"
        failureMessage = "Deployment name or instance prefix already exists"
        failureError = "The organization-scoped collision check returned " + str(len(results)) + " matching deployments."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        status = "ready"
        failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
        failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    failureError = "The collision response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "422"
failureMessage = "Create request mapping was rejected"
failureError = "The request body could not be mapped safely."
failureResult = "{}"
requestBody = ""
try:
    organizationMoid, definitionMoid, poolMoid, scheduleMoid = [x.strip() for x in sys.argv[1:5]]
    definition = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
    blueprints = json.loads(sys.argv[6]); qualifiers = json.loads(sys.argv[7]); tags = json.loads(sys.argv[8])
    definitionName = sys.argv[9]; usePreferred = sys.argv[10].lower() == "true"; version = int(sys.argv[11])
    deploymentName = sys.argv[12]; descriptionValue = sys.argv[13]; prefix = sys.argv[14]
    startIndex = int(sys.argv[15]); digitCount = int(sys.argv[16]); rollout = sys.argv[17]
    allowedQualifierKeys = {
        "resource.ChassisServersQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","SlotIds"},
        "resource.DomainQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","DomainNames","FabricInterConnectPids"},
        "resource.GpuQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","GpuControllersRange","GpuEvaluationType","Pids","Vendor"},
        "resource.MemoryQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","MemoryCapacityRange","MemoryUnitsRange"},
        "resource.NetworkAdaptorQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","AdaptorsRange"},
        "resource.ProcessorQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","CpuCoresRange","Pids","SpeedRange","Vendor"},
        "resource.OdataRuleSetQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","Rules"},
        "resource.BladeQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","AssetTags","ChassisAndSlotIdRange","ChassisPids","Pids","UserLabels"},
        "resource.RackServerQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","AssetTags","Pids","RackIdRange","UserLabels"},
        "resource.TagQualifier":{"ClassId","ObjectType","ChassisTags","DomainProfileTags","ServerTags"},
    }
    definitionBlueprints = definition.get("Blueprints") or []
    byName = {}
    for entry in definitionBlueprints:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not isinstance(entry.get("Name"), str):
            raise ValueError("The selected definition contains an invalid Blueprint reference.")
        byName.setdefault(entry["Name"], []).append(entry)
    seen = set()
    for override in blueprints:
        if not isinstance(override, dict) or override.get("ClassId") != "workload.BlueprintInputReference" or override.get("ObjectType") != "workload.BlueprintInputReference":
            raise ValueError("Every blueprint override needs matching workload.BlueprintInputReference discriminators.")
        name = override.get("Name")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or len(byName.get(name,[])) != 1 or name in seen:
            raise ValueError("Every override Name must map uniquely to one selected-definition blueprint and may appear once.")
        seen.add(name)
        expected = byName[name][0].get("Blueprint")
        supplied = override.get("Blueprint")
        if supplied not in (None,{}) and (not isinstance(supplied,dict) or not isinstance(expected,dict) or supplied.get("Moid") != expected.get("Moid")):
            raise ValueError("A supplied Blueprint relationship does not match the selected definition.")
    for qualifier in qualifiers:
        qualifierType = qualifier.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(qualifier,dict) else None
        if qualifierType not in allowedQualifierKeys or qualifier.get("ClassId") != qualifierType:
            raise ValueError("Every qualifier needs matching documented concrete discriminators.")
        unsupportedKeys = sorted(set(qualifier)-allowedQualifierKeys[qualifierType])
        if unsupportedKeys:
            raise ValueError("Qualifier "+qualifierType+" contains unsupported top-level keys: "+", ".join(unsupportedKeys)+".")
    orgRef = {"ClassId":"mo.MoRef","ObjectType":"organization.Organization","Moid":organizationMoid}
    mapper = {"ClassId":"workload.DefinitionMapper","ObjectType":"workload.DefinitionMapper","DefinitionName":definitionName,"Organization":orgRef,"UsePreferredVersion":usePreferred}
    if not usePreferred: mapper["Version"] = version
    payload = {"ClassId":"workload.WorkloadDeployment","ObjectType":"workload.WorkloadDeployment","Name":deploymentName,"WorkloadDefinitionReference":mapper,"ResourcePool":{"ClassId":"mo.MoRef","ObjectType":"resourcepool.Pool","Moid":poolMoid},"WorkloadInstancePrefix":prefix,"StartIndexForSuffix":startIndex,"DigitCount":digitCount,"Blueprints":blueprints,"Qualifiers":qualifiers,"RolloutStrategy":{"ClassId":"workload."+rollout+"Deployment","ObjectType":"workload."+rollout+"Deployment"},"Organization":orgRef,"Tags":tags}
    if descriptionValue: payload["Description"] = descriptionValue
    if scheduleMoid: payload["SchedulePolicy"] = {"ClassId":"mo.MoRef","ObjectType":"scheduler.SchedulePolicy","Moid":scheduleMoid}
    requestBody = json.dumps(payload,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)
    if json.loads(requestBody) != payload or definition.get("Moid") != definitionMoid:
        raise ValueError("The request body or selected definition identity failed round-trip validation.")
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    failureError = "Create mapping failed closed before POST: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError,"mutationSent":False},separators=(",",":"))
